The imaging features are classic for glioblastoma, which is the most common IDH-wildtype glioma. Specifically, the presence of marked, thick-rim enhancement (Enhancement Quality: 'Marked', Thickness of enhancing margin: '>3mm') and a very large proportion of central necrosis (Proportion Necrosis: 30.04%) are hallmark features of IDH-wildtype tumors. Furthermore, the involvement of deep structures like the thalamus and brainstem (Anatomical Overlap Regions) and ependymal invasion are also more frequently associated with IDH-wildtype gliomas. There are no features suggestive of an IDH-mutant tumor.
